class.name: MemoryDatabase
class.brief_description: A [NetwDatabaseBackend] that keeps records in this process and nowhere else.
class.description: Records live for as long as the process does. Reach for it in a test, in a prototype, or wherever a save that outlives the run would get in the way. [codeblock] Netw.configure_database(self, &"saves").backend(MemoryDatabase.new()) [/codeblock] It implements the whole backend contract, slots and scan cursors included, so a game written against it runs unchanged on a durable backend. Two backends sharing a [member store] share their records, which is how a reopen can be exercised without leaving the process. This is a shared store and not durability. The connection [method _open] answers reports [constant @GlobalScope.OK] for every read, scan and operation.

method.name: _delete_slot
method.description: Removes [param slot] and every record in it from [member store]. It resolves [constant @GlobalScope.OK] whether or not the slot existed.

method.name: _list_slots
method.description: Resolves every slot [member store] holds. It never rejects.

method.name: _open
method.description: Resolves a fresh [NetwDatabaseConnection] over [param slot] in [member store], creating the slot when it is absent. It never rejects.

members.member: The name of the in-process store this backend keeps its records in.
